newsitem.title: SENEGAL: West African customs chiefs pledge to fight fraud.
newsitem.headline: West African customs chiefs pledge to fight fraud.

text.p: West African customs chiefs ended their first conference on Wednesday, pledging to share more information to help combat fraud in the region.

"We pledge to be more active in the management and implementation of economic integration and to improve the exchange of information among services dealing with the fight against fraud," a final communique said.
Delegates said the focus would be on combating money laundering and the trade in arms and drugs which law enforcement agencies say are proliferating in the sub-region.

The three-day meeting brought together senior customs officials from the 16-nation Economic Community of West African States and observers from France, Gabon and Cameroon. The head of the World Customs Organisation, James Shaver, also attended.

The next conference will take place in a year's time in Nigeria, singled out by the United States as one of the biggest transit nations for drugs from Asia and Latin America destined for North America and Europe.
